title: Workshop Throughput Atlas
subtitle: One operating model viewed through capacity, flow, quality, and overflow
provenance: Illustrative values supplied in this brief; all outputs are synthetic planning estimates.

modules.question: Which inputs determine processed, completed, and excess arrivals?
modules.claim: Demand, capacity, and first-pass quality form one causal operating model.
modules.selectionRationale: A dependency network exposes the shared inputs and derived outcomes as one causal system.
modules.rejectedAlternative: A table was rejected because it would list the values without showing their dependency structure.

modules.question: What share of processed work succeeds on the first pass?
modules.claim: First-pass success shows the exact yield applied to processed work.
modules.selectionRationale: A radial gauge makes one bounded fraction and its distance from a perfect yield immediately legible.
modules.rejectedAlternative: A line chart was rejected because the brief supplies scenarios, not a sampled historical series.

modules.question: How close is demand to the available processing ceiling?
modules.claim: The load ratio crosses 100% exactly when demand exceeds capacity.
modules.selectionRationale: A bullet chart compares the demand-to-capacity ratio against a meaningful 100 percent threshold.
modules.rejectedAlternative: A decorative gauge was rejected because the threshold comparison is more important than circular progress.

modules.question: Where does each incoming item land after the first processing pass?
modules.claim: Incoming work resolves to completed, first-pass failed, or excess arrivals.
modules.selectionRationale: A Sankey-style flow keeps the incoming total connected to its three mutually related outcomes.
modules.rejectedAlternative: Independent bars were rejected because they would obscure the shared source and conservation reading.

modules.question: What are the exact current operating values?
modules.claim: A compact ledger anchors visual readings in inspectable numbers.
modules.selectionRationale: A compact table is the most precise cross-check for the exact values already encoded visually elsewhere.
modules.rejectedAlternative: Another chart was rejected because this module's task is exact lookup rather than pattern detection.

modules.question: How does capacity split incoming demand into processed and excess arrivals?
modules.claim: Excess arrivals appear only when incoming work exceeds available capacity.
modules.selectionRationale: A waterfall makes the arithmetic bridge from arrivals through processed work to overflow explicit.
modules.rejectedAlternative: A pie chart was rejected because signed arithmetic and the capacity boundary would be ambiguous.
